problem: Cross-chat continuity currently preserves authority, hashes and receipts but not all heavy derived payload bytes, forcing deterministic rematerialization in fresh runtimes.

current_evidence.historical_blocker_root_cause: No byte-preserving runtime-file upload action was exposed.
current_evidence.new_capability: Dropbox connector now exposes upload_file for local/conversation files plus download_link, while Dropbox.fetch can return full text content up to 5 MiB.
current_evidence.binary_runtime_readback_limit: Temporary binary download links exist, but this runtime's direct downloader cannot autonomously consume the Dropbox temporary URL because of orchestration safe-URL gating. Therefore raw-binary CAS is not accepted as the primary cross-runtime recovery path today.

git_repository.reason: GitHub enforces 100 MiB single-object limit and recommends repositories remain small.

git_lfs.reason: Included Free/Pro quota is 10 GiB storage and 10 GiB monthly bandwidth; each new LFS version consumes full object storage.

github_releases.reason: Release assets allow up to 1000 assets per release, each under 2 GiB, with no total release size or bandwidth limit, but current GitHub connector exposes release reads and no release-asset upload action.

github_actions_artifacts.reason: Usage storage is metered/limited and not intended as permanent immutable CAS authority.

dropbox_raw_binary.reason: upload_file now solves writer side; binary temporary-link readback into current runtime remains blocked by URL handoff boundary.

dropbox_base64_chunk_cas.reason: upload_file can persist local Base64 chunk files, while Dropbox.fetch can return each text chunk directly into a fresh runtime without temporary-URL transport.

preferred_architecture.name: QROS_DUAL_PLANE_CAS_V2
preferred_architecture.control_plane: GitHub main: HEAD/STATE/RUN_QUEUE, immutable artifact manifests, source hashes, receipts, promotion status and Dropbox locators.

chunk_format.reason: 4 MiB encoded object remains below Dropbox.fetch 5 MiB extraction ceiling with operational margin.

preferred_architecture.artifact_packaging: For directories/shards, create deterministic TAR plus compression where deterministic and beneficial; hash packaged bytes before chunking. For already compressed NPZ/ZIP do not recompress unless measured beneficial.
write_acceptance: remote Dropbox content_hash matches locally recomputed encoded-file Dropbox content hash
manifest committed to GitHub only after all chunks pass
fresh_runtime_recovery: fetch manifest from GitHub by exact path/blob
fetch each Base64 chunk from Dropbox by exact locator using Dropbox.fetch

storage_tiers.HOT_DURABLE: prepared shards, expensive context caches, outcome caches, promoted/economic shard outputs, checkpoint bundles required for cross-chat continuation
storage_tiers.COLD_REMATERIALIZABLE: cheap scratch arrays, compiler caches, temporary diagnostics that can be regenerated quickly
storage_tiers.CANONICAL: authoritative source carriers remain under existing canonical authority; do not duplicate all 20+ GiB ticks into Dropbox unless quota is proven sufficient and duplication adds real recovery value

remaining_gates_before_production.G1: Complete preregistered multi-object upload/readback using Base64 chunk files through upload_file + Dropbox.fetch, not binary temp URLs.
remaining_gates_before_production.G2: Fresh-runtime cross-chat recovery using only GitHub manifest + Dropbox chunk locators; previous runtime files forbidden.
remaining_gates_before_production.G3: Production-like object set at least one real expensive QROS derivative, not synthetic only, with full root SHA parity.
remaining_gates_before_production.G4: Account storage-capacity gate: current connector exposes no quota endpoint; do not assume enough Dropbox space. Adopt HOT_DURABLE selective persistence unless capacity is independently proven.
remaining_gates_before_production.G5: Negative tests: missing chunk, corruption, wrong order, stale locator, duplicate content, partial upload.

recommendation: Promote QROS_DUAL_PLANE_CAS_V2 only after G1-G5 pass. Until then continue deterministic rematerialization as fallback, but immediately persist new resumability-critical heavy artifacts after successful production qualification.
